mentions.name: seaticket
mentions.description: AI agent for issue tracking and management that connects fragmented sources such as GitHub, Discourse forums, email, and internal docs. It uses vector and keyword search to surface relevant context and related issues from all channels, helping support teams resolve issues faster.
mentions.problem: Issues and context are fragmented across GitHub, forums, email, and internal docs, so teams spent more time manually hunting for the right answer than actually working on the product.
mentions.audience: Developers, open source projects, and teams supporting self-hosted software.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on seaticket, an ai agent for issue tracking and management, built for developers, open source projects and teams supporting self hosted software.
